text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "I went to a board game cafe for the first time in a while, and they had an interesting new release."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's a turn-based PvP game, and the rules are—
well, it's hard to explain in words.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next time we're matching our days off.
Keep your schedule open for the whole day, got it?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: You're sticking with me until I'm satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership seems to have had
a fun day off!
